name: filmcraft-cli
notes: Companion command-line tool for filmcraft on macOS, consumed at runtime by server/install.mjs; the desktop DMG does not carry it, and the MCP server is this binary (filmcraft-cli mcp). Pinned 2026-11-04 to the v0.17.0 release (published 2026-11-03); digest from the release's SHA256SUMS.txt, byte count from GitHub asset metadata, both checked against the downloaded archive by the install drive. The drive exercises --version, MCP initialize, tools/list, command_list, a headless import, placement, cut, save and inspected export, and the bridge to a launched window. In bridge mode the CLI reads FILMCRAFT_CONTROL_TOKEN from its environment; the adapter supplies it there, never on the command line.
